definitions.explanation: Help or assistance given to someone, typically hands-on or practical support. Implies direct, personal involvement rather than institutional or formal aid.

examples.japanese: {手助|てだす}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手助|てだす}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。
examples.english: I finished the move with a friend's help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいたら、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{手助|てだす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: If someone is in trouble, I want to lend a hand, even if just a little.

notes:
{手助|てだす}け refers to practical, personal help — the kind you give by being directly involved rather than simply giving advice or money.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手助|てだす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lend a hand, to help out
- {手助|てだす}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: to need help
- {手助|てだす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to ask for help
- {手助|てだす}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be of help

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧: help (often used for everyday tasks; more casual)
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: aid, support (formal; often institutional or financial)
- ⟦{助力|じょりょく}→助力：15249_joryoku⟧: assistance (formal, literary)
